description: Writes a new Architecture Decision Record with a directed SUPERSEDES edge into HydraDB, immediately retiring the superseded rule from active agent context while preserving asOf history.

content.description: Normative text of the new decision.

governsIds.description: Target code or module node IDs governed by this decision.

newId.description: Node ID for the new decision (e.g. adr:ADR-025).

oldId.description: Node ID of the decision being retired (e.g. adr:ADR-014).

title.description: Human-readable title of the new decision.

name: hydrascope_supersede_decision
